rule.description: Allow doc clients and preserve verified export bytes

dynamicCatalogRateLimit.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/catalogs/") and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot and http.host ne "demo.manja.araihu.com" and not (http.host eq "oapi.araihu.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}))
dynamicCatalogRateLimit.note: Only the expression changed. Action, threshold, characteristics, mitigation timeout and every other rule were preserved.
